name: toggle
title: Toggle
description: A button that stays pressed, made from a label with a hidden checkbox.

classes.name: btn--toggle
classes.description: Use it on a <label class="btn"> that contains a checkbox. Shaded while the checkbox is checked.

notes: The checkbox stays in the accessibility tree and keyboard order; it is only visually hidden.
Only checkboxes are hidden by toggle.css; a radio inside a btn--toggle stays visible.
